opencli.description: web/social fetch through a real logged-in browser with image localization

agent-reach.description: multi-platform fetch routing; inspect its own doctor for per-platform availability

yt-dlp.description: video metadata, captions, and audio-only download

ffmpeg.description: audio conversion and cover handling for video captures
ffmpeg.install_cn: brew install ffmpeg with TUNA Homebrew bottle settings; on Windows use the gyan.dev build and add bin to PATH

sensevoice.description: SenseVoice/FunASR local ASR for Chinese video
sensevoice.install_cn: python3 -m venv ~/.local/share/llm-wiki/asr-venv && ~/.local/share/llm-wiki/asr-venv/bin/pip install funasr torch -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple

whisper-ctranslate2.description: faster Whisper-family local ASR for non-Chinese video
whisper-ctranslate2.install_cn: python3 -m pip install -U whisper-ctranslate2 -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple; set HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com for model download

whisper.description: stock OpenAI Whisper local ASR fallback
whisper.install_cn: python3 -m pip install -U openai-whisper -i https://pypi.tuna.tsinghua.edu.cn/simple; set HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com for model download
